scripts.pack:cpanel: python3 -c "import os, zipfile; z = zipfile.ZipFile('webspacekit-build.zip', 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED); [z.write(os.path.join(root, file), os.path.relpath(os.path.join(root, file), 'dist')) for root, _, files in os.walk('dist') for file in files]; z.close(); print('✨ Created webspacekit-build.zip ready for cPanel upload!')"
